# anime-sdk

> A TypeScript SDK for searching anime and manga, listing episodes/chapters, and resolving direct stream/image URLs. Nine live-tested providers, embed extractors, a pluggable HTTP transport, and an optional HTTP server with stream/subtitle proxy and cache.

## Install

```sh
npm install anime-sdk
# pnpm add anime-sdk  |  bun add anime-sdk
```

Requires Node 20+ and `ffmpeg` on PATH (E2E tests / HLS downloads only).

## Core pattern

Every provider exposes the same three methods:

```ts
import { HttpClient, AllmangaProvider } from 'anime-sdk';

const client = new HttpClient({ timeoutMs: 10_000 });
const provider = new AllmangaProvider(client);

const shows = await provider.search('Frieren');
const eps   = await provider.fetchContentUnits(shows[0].id);
const result = await provider.resolveStream(eps[0].id, 'sub');

if (result.type === 'video') {
  const { sourceUrl, isHLS, headers, subtitles } = result.streams[0];
}
```

`resolveStream` returns a discriminated union: `{ type: 'video'; streams: IVideoPayload[] }` for anime or `{ type: 'manga'; pages: IMangaPayload }` for manga.

## Providers

| ID            | Site              | Content | Languages     | Subtitles |
| ------------- | ----------------- | ------- | ------------- | --------- |
| allmanga      | allmanga.to       | ANIME   | sub, dub, raw | no        |
| animeparadise | animeparadise.moe | ANIME   | sub           | yes (VTT) |
| gogoanime     | anineko.to        | ANIME   | sub           | no        |
| anikoto       | anikototv.to      | ANIME   | sub, dub      | yes (VTT) |
| megaplay      | megaplay.buzz     | ANIME   | sub, dub      | yes (VTT) |
| goyabu        | goyabu.io         | ANIME   | raw (pt-br)   | no        |
| mangadex      | mangadex.org      | MANGA   | sub           | no        |
| weebcentral   | weebcentral.com   | MANGA   | sub           | no        |
| mangapill     | mangapill.com     | MANGA   | sub           | no        |

Best choices: **allmanga** for breadth (sub+dub, GraphQL), **megaplay** for robust AniList-based search, **mangadex** for manga.

## HTTP Server

```ts
import { startServer, AllmangaProvider, HttpClient } from 'anime-sdk';

startServer({
  providers: [new AllmangaProvider(new HttpClient())],
  port: 3000,
  proxy: true,           // enables /proxy and rewrites all stream/subtitle URLs
  cache: { get, set },   // optional: Map, Redis, SQLite, edge KV
  auth: { token: '…' },  // optional: bearer token
});
```

Routes: `GET /search`, `/content`, `/stream`, `/tracks`, `/proxy`, plus SSE download routes `/download/video/progress`, `/download/manga/chapter/progress` and file retrieval routes.

## Downloads

```ts
import { downloadVideo, downloadMangaChapter } from 'anime-sdk';

// Anime → MP4 (HLS segments muxed with ffmpeg, or direct fetch for MP4 streams)
const { outputPath, fileSize } = await downloadVideo(result.streams, './episode-1.mp4', {
  onProgress: ({ phase, detail }) => console.log(phase, detail),
});

// Manga → ZIP
const { pageCount } = await downloadMangaChapter(result.pages, './chapter-1.zip', {
  onProgress: ({ downloaded, total }) => console.log(downloaded, '/', total),
});
```
